physics_goals.quote: (i) Precision measurement of the value of R = σ (e+e– hadron)/σ(e+e– μ+μ–).
physics_goals.value: Precision measurement of R and of hadron channels e+e- -> 2h, 3h, 4h and of excited vector mesons; test of vector-current conservation; nucleon form factors; radiative return; two-photon physics (the VEPP-2000 physics programme)

summary.plain: The Cryogenic Magnetic Detector 3 at the VEPP-2000 collider of the Budker Institute in Novosibirsk, taking data since 2010 at energies up to 2 GeV. Its measurement of the pion form factor, important for predicting the muon's magnetic moment, reaches 0.7% systematic uncertainty.
summary.technical: CMD-3 at VEPP-2000 (0.3-2.0 GeV c.m.): drift chamber and Z-chamber, TOF, LXe, CsI and BGO calorimeters, muon veto and a superconducting solenoid of 1.0-1.3 T; installed October 2009; 1 fb⁻¹ collected by June 2026; e⁺e⁻ → π⁺π⁻ measured from threshold to 1.2 GeV with 0.7% systematic uncertainty near the ρ resonance.
